sources.note: For BAHINEMO: sec. 4.2 pp. 4-5, accented words (nouns, pronouns, adjectives, adverbs) have one accented syllable carrying highest tone and heavier stress; position lexical ('All possible patterns occur in two and three syllable words.. Final syllable stress is the predominant pattern'); unaccented words = verb roots, sentence stress falls on the first verbal prefix; sec. 4.3 tone patterns; nothing about the separate wagu1234 language (mentions 'original speakers in Wagu' only re Bahinemo pronoun variants, 8.1.5)
